_source: Default bindings (issue #113; traced in wiki document 137, the shape is the engine's PlayerControls). Three sets, as the original keeps them in its 66-halfword registry block: one_player, two_player_1, two_player_2. Each control lists its bindings, all live and ORed (FUN_0041b890): a key (Godot's name), an input action, or 'joy:<code>', one of the original's 24 joystick input codes (FUN_0041cb00). two_player_1 / two_player_2 are the original's defaults (FUN_0041c990 keys: W S A D, Q E, H J K and keypad 8 5 4 6, 7 9, - + Enter; FUN_0041ca40 joystick codes). one_player keeps the original's joystick defaults, but its keys are a PORT CHOICE (user, 2026-10-12): the port's own keys on the same three-button scheme, the arrows and ui_accept (Space, Enter) as A, Z as B, X as C, Q and E as the shoulders; the original's one-player keys are the same as two_player_1's.
